note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), the original in English; alate unknown; the original records the clypeus, labrum and mandibles of the soldier only as 'as in E. hamatus', so this cross-reference is retained without adding morphological details; synonymy lists, literature citations and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, longer and narrower than in E. hamatus; labrum and mandibles as in E. hamatus; antennal segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 as long as segment 3; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow; mandible apex brown; body white. Head with scattered short hairs; abdomen densely covered with short hairs. Body length 5.0–5.50 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide; head length (excluding mandibles) 1.90 mm, maximum width 1.14 mm; shape longer and narrower than in E. hamatus. Clypeus, labrum and mandibles as in E. hamatus. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 as long as segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch; width 0.72 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow, body white. Hairs sparse. Head oval, narrowed anteriorly; maximum head width 0.80 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe relatively large, without a notch; maximum width 0.57 mm.
